stories.title: VIDEO: EU opens door for Canada as first-ever "associate member"
stories.angle: Breaking wait-what for the LIST: Ursula von der Leyen, with Mark Carney in Strasbourg, proposes making Canada the EU's first associate member — a category that doesn't even exist in the treaties yet. Carney has framed this as a unique alliance, not full membership. You're asking listeners: smart pivot away from Trump/US trade chaos, or a sovereignty trap dressed up as friendship?
bullets: Von der Leyen (primary X video 0:36): wants Canada relationship at the highest level; opens door to first EU associate membership
Clash Report stinger (0:13): short breaking soundbite of the same pitch to Carney
Reuters + AP + CTV corroborate overnight; Carney has said Canada wants a unique alliance — not joining the EU as a full member
Context: Canada diversifying away from U.S. tariff/pressure drama while still next door to America
Caller fuel: do you want deeper Europe ties if it means new rules, expectations, or diluted independence?
stories.debate: Smart pivot away from Trump/US — or a sovereignty trap?

stories.title: VIDEO: Stephen Harper — Canada should be an energy superpower (and why we aren't)
stories.angle: This is your clean Canada-politics LIST beat that isn't airports or the mega deduction. Harper's CPAC run is clip-dense: he says Canada was poised to be an energy superpower in 2015, then deliberate policy choices knocked us off that path — and he warns we can't let Trump hollow out our industrial capacity. You're asking listeners: is energy + resources still our comparative advantage, or is that yesterday's Canada?
bullets: Harper (via @sarobertson_ CPAC clips): Canada should be a major global energy supplier whatever the future mix
Key line: in 2015 we were poised to be that superpower — today we aren't, because of policy choices over the next decade
Also: resource endowment is Canada's special comparative advantage; don't let the U.S. administration hollow out our industrial capacity
Extra clip: @oldcanadaseries Harper at the Carney Summit in Toronto (1:39)
Caller fuel: energy superpower ambition vs. climate politics — which Canada do you want?
stories.debate: Should Canada still chase being an energy superpower — or is that the wrong fight for 2026?

stories.title: Zyrtec + Pepcid ADHD TikTok claim — doctors say allergy, internet says hack

You're not giving medical advice; you're asking listeners whether they'd try a viral combo on a stranger's thread, or if this is exactly how health misinfo spreads.

Host guardrail: debate the phenomenon, do not endorse dosing or self-medication
